tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the root README and graph README to understand the admin app role, setup, deployment, and graph dashboard workflow.

tour.title: Bootstrap And Routing
tour.description: Follow the React entry point and protected route shell to see how public routes, guarded routes, tenant data, app settings, and feature pages connect.

tour.title: Runtime Configuration
tour.description: Review runtime config, endpoint constants, public env injection, and container startup before touching backend URLs or deployment variables.

tour.title: Auth And Permissions
tour.description: Understand login, token storage, route guarding, role parsing, resource permissions, tenant settings, and release-toggle gates.

tour.title: API And Hooks
tour.description: Trace a typical page through React Query hooks, domain API helpers, endpoint constants, and the shared authenticated fetch wrapper.

tour.title: High-Change Feature Areas
tour.description: Inspect the current user-management, external inbound links, and statistics dashboard modules because they concentrate recent UI and data-flow changes.

tour.title: Delivery Pipeline
tour.description: Finish with CI and Docker/nginx delivery files to understand how npm build output becomes the `/admin` container image.
